tagline.en: A live session view on DSH; a one-screen overview report on every other host.
tagline.zh: DSH 上装实时视图，其余宿主出一屏会话概览。

modes.summary: Install a session-scoped view/tab into a host that exposes a UI registry.
Emit a one-screen Markdown or HTML overview from facts already in the session.

hosts.label: DeepSeek Harness
hosts.verified: 0.2.1-rc.5: discovered from .agents/skills and loaded by name
hosts.notes: SKILL.md is the native format; discovery roots include <project>/.agents/skills and <project>/.dsh/skills. Only host that can install the Mode A view.

hosts.label: WorkBuddy
hosts.verified: builtin skill layout inspected on disk
hosts.notes: Same SKILL.md folder layout; description_en and license are tolerated extra keys. Report mode only: its extensions offer full-page ui.entry and artifactPreviews, with no conversation-level view slot.

hosts.label: Codex CLI
hosts.notes: No local skill directory contract assumed: use the AGENTS.md snippet or the custom prompt.

hosts.label: Qoder
hosts.notes: Rule file plus AGENTS.md snippet. Report mode only: it is a VS Code core, so a webview extension could exist, but no public API exposes the live agent session state.

hosts.label: Doubao agent
hosts.notes: Paste-ready agent instructions; report mode only.

hosts.label: Any other agent
hosts.notes: System-prompt or AGENTS.md fragment; the agent follows SKILL.md in this repo.

permissions.filesystem: read (Mode B evidence); write only for the HTML report the user asked for
permissions.install: Mode A installs a plugin bundle into the host profile; require explicit user approval
